votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act (H R 1011)
votes.bill_title: Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act of 2025
votes.plain_language: This bill revises the Emergency Conservation Program and the Emergency Forest Restoration Program to expand eligibility for payments to agricultural producers and owners of forest land impacted by natural disasters. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.bill_title: KIDS Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires specified online platforms to establish safeguards for minors. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Small Business Technological Advancement Act (H R 915)
votes.bill_title: Small Business Technological Advancement Act
votes.plain_language: This bill authorizes the Small Business Administration to finance, under its 7(a) loan program, business software or cloud computing services, including tools that use artificial intelligence. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.bill_title: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act

votes.bill_title: AI for Main Street Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Main Street Parity Act (H R 5763)
votes.bill_title: Main Street Parity Act
votes.plain_language: This bill lessens the financing requirements for certain Small Business Administration loans to small businesses for plant acquisition, construction, conversion, or expansion, including the acquisition of land.
